lead.headline: Scale-separated quasi-dS and the Swampland
body: Ideas from the Swampland program (dS conjecture and TCC) suggest that it is impossible to obtain solutions of string theory/M-theory in the weak-coupling regions describing our current universe, with $V>0$, $\|\nabla V\|/V < 2/\sqrt{d-2}$ and $V \ll m^2$ (scale-separated "quasi-dS") where $m$ is the mass of the light tower. We test this expectation in M-theory compactifications and find that even after including the quantum effect of Casimir energy, for hyperbolic and (rigid) Riemann-flat manifolds, de Sitter critical points under EFT control are excluded: the slope of the potential cannot drop below the asymptotic value predicted by the TCC $\|\nabla V\|/V\gtrsim 2/\sqrt{d-2}$ except perhaps in an order-one region in the bulk of moduli space, where EFT control is lost.

features.headline: Stanley Deser 19th March 1931 - 21st April 2023
body: Stanley Deser was Ancell Professor Emeritus at Brandeis University and Visiting Professor at the California Institute of Technology. He was a world-renowned theoretical physicist whose accomplishments include the Arnowitt-Deser-Misner (ADM) formulation of general relativity, supergravity with Zumino, the dynamics of flat space with Jackiw and 't Hooft and many other contributions to the quantum theory of gravity.
In the 1980s he was instrumental in securing National Science Foundation approval of the LIGO gravitational wave experiment against much opposition.
features.authors: M. J. Duff and K. S. Stelle

features.headline: Two-Loop $n$-Point Identical Helicity Amplitude for Gravity Minimally Coupled to a Chiral Fermion
body: Motivated by recent developments in the two-loop identical-helicity sector of gauge theory when the one-loop self-dual integrability anomaly of Bardeen and Cangemi, or the equivalent twistor-space version of Costello and Paquette, vanishes, we compute the two-loop four-point identical-helicity amplitude in gravity coupled to a single chiral fermion, for which the corresponding self-dual anomaly also vanishes. We show that the infrared-subtracted amplitude is purely rational and proportional to the identical-helicity tree amplitude of pure gravity with a single insertion of the operator $R^3$.

features.headline: Proof of the QNEC, without assumptions and under a weight
body: We complete a proof of the quantum null energy condition (QNEC) in the mathematical framework of Half-Sided Translations and Modular Inclusions (HST/HSMI) removing an assumption that applied to previous proofs. Here we establish a theorem, which when translated to a physical setting implies that the relative entropy comparing the state of fields outside a stationary black hole with a Hartle-Hawking (HH) state is always a convex function of the horizon cut.

stories.headline: Proof of the Rényi QNEC
body: We give a general proof of the Rényi QNEC formulated using the Araki-Masuda weighted $L_p$ norms for all $p > 2$. This generalizes the algebraic proof of the QNEC applicable at $p=2$.
Our approach utilizes a weighted version of a conditional $L_p$ norm which extrapolates the quantum expansion/ant-quantity.

stories.headline: Cubic Curvature Corrections to Taub-NUT-AdS Black Holes and Their Thermodynamics
body: We investigate cubic curvature corrections to four-dimensional Taub-NUT-AdS black holes and their thermodynamics. We construct the complete analytic solution to the first order in the higher-derivative couplings, and derive the corrected Hawking temperature and Wald entropy.

stories.headline: Liberation in the Heavy Limit
body: We study CFT four-point functions of identical scalar primaries as their dimension $Δ$ grows for fixed $0<z, \bar z<1$, and call them liberated if they grow at the same exponential rate as those of a generalized free field (GFF), as is the case for heavy free particles propagating along geodesics in AdS.

stories.headline: Monodromy Defects and Bulk Renormalization Group Flows on the Fuzzy Sphere
body: A monodromy around a defect specifies a symmetry transformation, but the low energy properties of the defect depend on its interaction with bulk degrees of freedom and also itself. We study this dependence on the fuzzy sphere.
Along an anisotropy flow, an $O(3)$ half-twist approaches the $O(2)$ half-twist when its twisted components stay light and disappears when they become massive.

stories.headline: Integrable AdS$_2$ branes in mixed flux AdS$_3$
body: We show that half-BPS D3-branes wrapping AdS$_2\times$S$^2$ in AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times$T$^4$ with mixed NSNS and RR flux define integrable boundary conditions for the supercoset sigma model of the Green--Schwarz superstring. This extends the integrable D-branes of Dekel and Oz to backgrounds with a Wess--Zumino term, and previous bosonic results for mixed flux to the full superstring.

stories.headline: eAdS- embedded AdS, tensionless strings and contracted Carroll-Weyl symmetry
body: We adapt the Dirac conformal $d+2$ dimensional embedding construction to define a null string in $AdS_{d+1}$. Introducing an extra Stückelberg field $\varphi$, which is a scalar under $AdS$ and shifts under local scaling of embedding space, the model acquires a local scaling invariance.

stories.headline: The tertiary invariant and discrete Green-Schwarz couplings in heterotic string theory
body: The tertiary invariant is a recently introduced pairing between two-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=(0,1)$ supersymmetric quantum field theories, motivated by topological modular forms. We evaluate it directly from its definition for the sigma models on $\mathrm{Sp}(2)$ and $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ with unit $H$-flux, paired with the internal theories of the non-supersymmetric $\mathfrak{so}(16)\oplus\mathfrak{so}(16)$ heterotic string and of the near-horizon region of the non-supersymmetric heterotic 6-brane, respectively.

stories.headline: Irregularization of punctures: From $T_N$ to Argyres--Douglas via $\mathcal{N}=1$ flow
body: In this paper, we directly relate constructions of two large classes of $4d$ strongly coupled SCFTs: 1) compactifications of type $\mathfrak{g}$ $6d$ $(2,0)$ theories on spheres with irregular punctures leading to the $D_p(\mathfrak{g})$ Argyres--Douglas theories, and 2) the compactifications of the same $6d$ $(2,0)$ theories on spheres with regular punctures.

sections.name: Across the Border
sections.note: Papers whose primary category is not hep-th (mostly gr-qc), cross-listed into it

stories.headline: Variational Approach to the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon Equations of Motion for Extended Objects in General Relativity
body: The exact motion of a finite size object in curved spacetime is captured by the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations. They associate a unique worldline, momentum, and spin to that object and determine the evolution of such in terms of its fully independent multipole moments.

stories.headline: Black-hole ringdown at an exceptional point
body: Black holes ring in damped oscillations. At an exceptional point, photon-sphere and near-horizon modes merge, and their response can acquire a linear time factor.
We compute its amplitude from constrained Einstein-Maxwell data for a rotating, charged black hole in de Sitter space.

stories.headline: Engineering a digital acoustic black hole
body: We show how to design and build an analogue black hole as a synchronous digital circuit. We define the sound speed, the flow and the horizon of such a circuit in terms of its own logic, and realise one on a field-programmable gate array, where the black hole is probed electrically with a signal generator and an oscilloscope.

briefs.headline: Matrix-vector models for the 3D Ising CFT
briefs.text: The construction of three-dimensional conformal field theories (3D CFTs) using interacting fermions in the lowest Landau level on a sphere has recently proven remarkably efficient, while it differs from that of conventional field theories on the fuzzy sphere.

briefs.headline: Small Defects at Large Charge
briefs.text: We compute conformal data of cusped line defects with impurities for the abelian Higgs model in the semiclassical large-charge limit.

briefs.headline: Global Green-Schwarz response on quaternionic sphere bundles
briefs.text: Local anomaly polynomials describe local variations, but a normalized Green-Schwarz phase also depends on global background data.

briefs.headline: Boundary Formula for Volume Response of Entanglement Wedge Polygons
briefs.text: The vacuum volume of an entanglement wedge polygon is topological.

briefs.headline: On Thermodynamic Role of the Gauss-Bonnet Topological Term
briefs.text: We revisit the thermodynamic implications of the Gauss-Bonnet topological term in four spacetime dimensions.

briefs.headline: Deep Inelastic Scattering and Proton Structure Functions in AdS/QCD models
briefs.text: In this work we study the holographical fermionic deep inelastic scattering in a deformed AdS model.
briefs.authors: Rafael A. Costa-Silva and Henrique Boschi-Filho

briefs.headline: Zeta function in Coulomb background
briefs.text: We calculate the one-loop vacuum energy of a massive scalar field confined to the interior of a sphere with Dirichlet boundary conditions and subject to a Coulomb background potential $α/r$.
briefs.authors: M. Bordag and I. G. Pirozhenko

briefs.headline: Critical Slowing Down and the Crossover to Quantum Scrambling in Holographic CFTs
briefs.text: We investigate critical relaxation dynamics and their connection to quantum information scrambling in the conformal field theory dual to a Reissner-Nordström anti-de Sitter (RN-AdS) black hole.
briefs.authors: Mozib Bin Awal and Prabwal Phukon

briefs.headline: M-theory anomaly localization and holographic $c$-extremization
briefs.text: We compute the cubic and $C_3\wedge X_8$ caracteristic class contributions to the trial anomaly polynomial of supersymmetric $AdS_3\times M_8$ backgrounds with $M_8=P(\mathcal O \oplus \mathcal L)\to B_6$.

briefs.headline: Einstein--Yang--Mills Plane Waves: Uniqueness and an Exact Curvature Double Copy
briefs.text: Coleman found plane waves of Yang--Mills theory that are genuinely non-abelian in four dimensions and yet obey linear field equations, and Güven showed that they remain exact when gravity is included.

briefs.headline: Semiclassical Asymptotics of Entanglement in Torus-Link States
briefs.text: We investigate the entanglement entropy of topological quantum states associated with $T_{d,\,dn}$ torus links in (2+1)-dimensional SU(2) Chern--Simons theory at level $k$.

briefs.headline: Discretising 2D Fermionic CFTs
briefs.text: We extend the exact fixed-point tensor construction of Cheng et al. to fermionic minimal models, providing an analytic construction of fixed-point tensors for fermionic rational conformal field theories.

briefs.headline: Spectral function, OPE, and QNMs detect different singular points of black branes with unequal R-charges
briefs.text: We consider black brane solutions in the STU model, with three R-charges labeled by the parameters $q_1,q_2,q_3$.

briefs.headline: Configurational Information and Hadron Spectroscopy in Holographic QCD
briefs.text: Based on the concepts of entropy and complexity, Configurational Information Measures (CIMs) are tools capable of extracting information regarding physical systems from their spatially localized energy density, determining properties such as stability limits and phase transitions.

briefs.headline: Non-Relativistic Supersymmetric Gauge Theories and Soliton Solutions
briefs.text: This paper investigates non-relativistic supersymmetric gauge theories obtained through null reduction, with particular focus on supersymmetric Abelian Higgs models and their soliton solutions.

briefs.headline: Large-D approach to nearly critical holographic matter and Yang-Mills deconfinement
briefs.text: We study a systematic expansion of dynamical black hole solutions in a class of five-dimensional Einstein-dilaton theories that are holographically dual to nearly critical, strongly coupled four-dimensional field theories.

briefs.headline: Scalar quasinormal modes of the exact spinning Morris--Thorne wormhole
briefs.text: We study the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a minimally coupled massless scalar field on the exact spinning Morris-Thorne wormhole. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Direct product geometries in $n$-dimensional linear, quadratic, and conformal gravity
briefs.text: Direct-product spacetimes offer a tractable route to exact solutions in gravity theories beyond general relativity. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: The Energy-Momentum Tensor of a Compact Object in General Relativity to all Multipole Orders
briefs.text: In effective field theory approaches to compact object motion in general relativity, spin and tidal effects are encoded by operators formed from the Riemann tensor and its derivatives. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Emergent de Sitter Universes in Non-Hermitian Holography
briefs.text: We construct a class of asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS), regular black holes whose interiors evolve into nonsingular, expanding de Sitter (dS) cosmologies.

briefs.headline: First-order origins of second-order supersymmetry
briefs.text: One-dimensional second-order supersymmetry is constructed from conserved first-order operators on a surface with a cyclic coordinate.
briefs.authors: Stevan Cebrian and Mikhail S. Plyushchay

briefs.headline: The Ghost and Its Secret Partner
briefs.text: The propagator of a ghost field acquires a pair of first-sheet complex conjugate poles above the multi-particle threshold.

briefs.headline: Holographic warped CFTs on AdS$_3$, parity violation and unitarity
briefs.text: We consider recently introduced boundary conditions for General Relativity on AdS$_3$, whose canonical generators span the warped conformal algebra, in the case of the Einstein-Hilbert action supplemented by parity-odd terms that do not modify the field equations in vacuum.

briefs.headline: Baby Universes Nucleate by Hiding Observers from the Boundary
briefs.text: Observers are expected to be essential to describe closed universes, but their description within a conventional holographic theory remains challenging.
briefs.authors: Sergio E. Aguilar-Gutierrez and Takato Mori

briefs.headline: Nonlinear Scalarization of Reissner-Nordström Black Holes in Scalar-Torsion-Maxwell Teleparallel Gravity
briefs.text: We investigate the nonlinear scalarization of Reissner-Nordström black holes in scalar-torsion-Maxwell teleparallel gravity, in which the scalar field is nonminimally coupled to the Weitzenböck invariant. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Thermodynamic, Optical, and Wave Signatures of Charged Letelier AdS Black Holes with PFDM and Quintessence
briefs.text: We study a four-dimensional charged Letelier--anti-de Sitter (AdS) black-hole metric containing a cloud of strings, a phenomenological perfect-fluid-dark-matter (PFDM) source, and a Kiselev-type quintessence term. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Scalar-tensor reconstruction of coherent quantum black holes
briefs.text: We construct a scalar-tensor realisation of spherically symmetric black hole geometries that effectively arise from quantum coherent states characterised by a finite core and finite extension. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Shallow-water black holes and lattice superradiance
briefs.text: Rotating black holes can amplify waves that scatter off them, a process known as superradiance that fluid analogues bring into the laboratory. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Rotating the Replica: Twisted Rényi Coefficients from CFT Operator Counting
briefs.text: We show that twisting vacuum Rényi entropies by a spatial rotation reveals conformal field theory data governing the asymptotic counting of spinning operators.

briefs.headline: Kinematically Unrestricted Flat Space Scattering from AdS$_{d+1} \times$ S$^p$/CFT$_d$
briefs.text: We construct scattering states for scalar fields with generic kinematics from CFT operators in the flat space limit of AdS/CFT.

briefs.headline: An RG perspective on the (un)naturalness of Starobinsky inflation
briefs.text: Starobinsky inflation is often regarded as a successful minimal model of the early universe, yet it relies on a large $R^2$-coupling, in apparent tension with the expectation that Wilson coefficients in a gravitational effective field theory are of the same order.

briefs.headline: Fast, training-free simplification of spinor-helicity amplitudes
briefs.text: We present a training-free method that simplifies massless spinor-helicity expressions by a greedy best-first search over on-shell identities, and test it at four, five, and six points.

briefs.headline: Thermodynamics of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson black holes from background subtraction
briefs.text: The non-asymptotic flatness of charged rotating black holes immersed in the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field causes the ambiguity in the gauge choice for the time generator and the horizon electric potential. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: On a soliton with a non-normalisable zero mode
briefs.text: We consider the holomorphic baby Skyrme model, which we propose as a simple tractable example of a soliton with a non-normalisable zero mode.

briefs.headline: Landau-Ginzburg Theory of a Holographic Superconductor: A Horizon Perspective on the Zero-Temperature Ground State
briefs.text: We investigate the effect of a quartic scalar self-interaction, $λ|φ|^4$, on a holographic superconductor in which non-linear electrodynamic couplings generate a superconducting dome containing an extended Lifshitz regime.

briefs.headline: Decoupling Across Dimensions
briefs.text: We present a prescription for identifying decoupled sectors of 4d SCFTs obtained from compactifications of branes.

briefs.headline: ERG, axions, and a PT-symmetric accelerating Universe
briefs.text: In conventional quantum mechanics, the Hamiltonian is required to be Hermitian, ensuring real energy eigenvalues. (primary category gr-qc)
briefs.authors: Nick E. Mavromatos and Sarben Sarkar

briefs.headline: The Gribov problem on the horizon: A short guide to the Gribov-Zwanziger framework and its refinement
briefs.text: Gauge fixing in Yang-Mills theories encounters a non-perturbative obstruction: distinct gauge-equivalent configurations can satisfy the same gauge condition.
